text:
maria (PM): quick q — for the automatic fallback policy UX: when the system auto-degrades (e.g. heavy latency -> cheaper model) do we show a visible 'degraded' state in the console or keep it silent unless an operator digs in? :thinking:

sam (eng-platform): i'd prefer explicit but lightweight. a small badge on the route that says 'degraded' with tooltip 'served by fallback model' and a link to the audit entry. otherwise it's invisible and operators get surprised. :eyes:

jian (ops): explicit badge please. also need the incident surface: is this counted against customer SLOs? if we silently fallback we should still surface it for billing/alerts.

luca (ux): mock idea: compact pill "AUTO-FALLBACK" (amber) that expands to a 1-line reason + last 3 events. clicking opens a playback panel that shows requests and why they routed. low visual weight but discoverable. sketching now.

anjali (security): two constraints — (1) anything that exposes request content in the playback must honor PII redaction/KMS policies, (2) audit retention defaults need to match compliance plans. we should include redaction markers in the audit entries.

devin (runtime): a note on semantics — sometimes the fallback is mid-request (partial token generation fails). we have three distinct UX states: soft-fallback (next request routed to cheaper model), midstream-fallback (response truncated + retry), and silent-replace (no visible disruption). We should reflect those 3 in the UI. Example policy snippet we've used: 
```yaml
policy: 
  trigger: latency_p95 > 500ms
  mode: immediate_fallback
  fallback_model: small-chat-v1
```
If mode==immediate_fallback show pill; if mode==silent_replace show only audit.

sasha (telemetry-bot): telemetry must include these fields on fallback events: ["fallback_reason","fallback_mode","original_model","fallback_model","trace_id","error_code","quota_bucket","customer_id_masked"]. We can add an event type `auto_fallback.v1` so queries + alerts are easy.

maria (PM): good list. two product questions: 1) does fallback consumption charge against original model quota or fallback model quota? 2) can the rollout UI simulate the fallback so customer/product can preview what would happen?

sam (eng-platform): on quotas — runtime currently charges against the model that ultimately served tokens. that means switching to fallback reduces cost for us but may surprise customers using pinned model quotas. we should surface that in the UI and maybe offer a toggle: "Charge to original model quota (for predictability)".

jian (ops): toggle is essential for enterprise customers. also need a "dry-run" mode that records audit events but doesn't change routing.

luca (ux): "simulate" button idea: runs a dry-run traffic replay against the policy and shows sample sample traces w/ reasons. we can show a before/after cost estimate per 1k reqs. small modal, not a destructive action.

anjali (security): simulation must not copy sensitive request payloads to the UI. show redacted diffs and only allow exports to approved S3 bucket with retention tags.

sasha (telemetry-bot): the dry-run should write `fallback_simulation.v1` events and mark them as `simulated:true` so they don't trigger alerts or billing analytics.

devin (runtime): implementation notes: we can reuse the existing routing sandbox endpoint to run a policy on a small replay buffer. cost estimate needs token-length distribution sampling. also add a `why_did_you_fallback_url` in the audit entry pointing to a pre-filtered playback view.

maria (PM): ok actionable plan?

sam (eng-platform): i'll prototype console pill + playback link (PR -> eng-platform-review).

sasha (telemetry-bot): i'll add event schema for `auto_fallback.v1` and `fallback_simulation.v1` and a migration doc for downstream dashboards.

luca (ux): i'll drop the mock and high-fidelity interaction (simulate modal + cost chart) by EOD Thurs.

anjali (security): i'll list the redaction rules and retention defaults; need to sign off on export flows.

jian (ops): i'll draft operator runbook entries: alerting thresholds for fallback spikes, and how to toggle quota-charge behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: platform/ui/fallback-pill -> prod (hash: d9f3a2)

maria (PM): perfect — thanks everyone. follow-ups pinned: sam->proto, sasha->schema, luca->mock, anjali->policy, jian->runbook. we'll review in next platform sync. :thumbsup:
